entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Husayn, a notable figure in the history of Saudi Arabia, associated with Hejaz under the Caliphates (661–930). Preceded by Umayyad and Abbasid Hejaz. Their legacy influenced Siege of Mecca — Umayyad forces damage the Kaaba during the Second Fitna and Carmathians sack Mecca and steal the Black Stone from the Kaaba.
